name: server-management
description: Production host operations for term_5: capacity, services, listening ports, journals, Docker/Nginx readiness and conservative allowlisted service control.
guidelines: Inspect host capacity and service state before making production changes.
Use production_readiness for a broad preflight instead of issuing many redundant probes.
Use server_journal only for allowlisted services and keep log reads bounded.
Never use service control as a substitute for diagnosing an application-level problem.
Restart or stop a host service only when the explicit server-write gate is enabled and the service is allowlisted.
Prefer application lifecycle tools for application containers; reserve server service control for the host layer.
definition_of_done: Docker and public-routing dependencies are available
registered applications and deployments are accounted for
production changes remain attributable to Git/deployment state
host service mutations are allowlisted and explicitly gated
